    <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';
      var B = window.LWBoard, DATA = null, statusFilter = '';

      function rel(ts) {
        var secs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000 - ts);
        if (secs < 60) return 'just now';
        if (secs < 3600) return Math.floor(secs / 60) + 'm ago';
        if (secs < 86400) return Math.floor(secs / 3600) + 'h ago';
        return Math.floor(secs / 86400) + 'd ago';
      }

      function renderRecent() {
        var box = document.getElementById('bd-recent');
        var chip = document.getElementById('bd-recent-filter');
        chip.hidden = !statusFilter;
        chip.textContent = statusFilter ? statusFilter + ' ✕' : '';
        chip.onclick = function () { statusFilter = ''; renderRecent(); };
        chip.classList.toggle('bd-clickable', !!statusFilter);
        var rows = (DATA.recent || []).filter(function (g) {
          return !statusFilter || g.status === statusFilter;
        });
        if (!rows.length) {
          B.empty(box, statusFilter
            ? 'No recent goals with status "' + statusFilter + '".'
            : 'No goals yet.');
          return;
        }
        box.textContent = '';
        var table = document.createElement('table');
        var thead = document.createElement('thead');
        thead.innerHTML = '<tr><th scope="col">Nº</th><th scope="col">Status</th>' +
          '<th scope="col">Title</th><th scope="col">Updated</th></tr>';
        table.appendChild(thead);
        var tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
        rows.forEach(function (g) {
          var tr = document.createElement('tr');
          var td1 = document.createElement('td');
          var code = document.createElement('code');
          code.textContent = '#' + g.id;
          td1.appendChild(code);
          var td2 = document.createElement('td');
          var badge = B.el('span', 'badge ' + g.status, g.status);
          td2.appendChild(badge);
          var td3 = document.createElement('td');
          var a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = '/chat/goal/' + g.id;
          a.style.color = 'var(--text)';
          a.style.textDecoration = 'none';
          a.textContent = g.title;
          td3.appendChild(a);
          var td4 = B.el('td', 'muted', rel(g.updated_at));
          td4.title = new Date(g.updated_at * 1000).toLocaleString();
          tr.appendChild(td1); tr.appendChild(td2);
          tr.appendChild(td3); tr.appendChild(td4);
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
        table.appendChild(tbody);
        box.appendChild(table);
      }

      function render(D) {
        DATA = D;
        var k = document.getElementById('bd-kpis');
        k.textContent = '';
        k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Total goals', value: D.totals.total,
          sub: 'all time on record',
          spark: D.daily.map(function (r) { return r.started; }) }));
        k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Active now', value: D.totals.active,
          sub: D.totals.active ? 'running under budget caps' : 'nothing in flight' }));
        k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Delivered', value: D.window.delivered,
          chip: { cur: D.window.delivered, prev: D.window.delivered_prev },
          sub: 'in the last ' + D.days + ' days', sparkCls: 'ok',
          spark: D.daily.map(function (r) { return r.delivered; }) }));
        k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Blocked', value: D.totals.blocked,
          sub: D.totals.blocked ? 'needs a human look' : 'nothing stuck' }));

        var weekly = D.days > 60;
        B.area(document.getElementById('bd-momentum'), {
          data: weekly ? B.bucketWeekly(D.daily, ['started', 'delivered']) : D.daily,
          x: 'd',
          series: [{ key: 'started', label: 'Started', cls: 'brand' },
                   { key: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered', cls: 'ok' }],
          aria: 'Goals started and delivered per ' + (weekly ? 'week' : 'day') +
                ' over the last ' + D.days + ' days.',
          tipHead: function (r) { return (weekly ? 'Week of ' : '') + r.d; },
          xTick: function (r, i, n) {
            return i % Math.ceil(n / 8) === 0 ? r.d.slice(5) : '';
          } });

        B.donut(document.getElementById('bd-mix'), {
          segments: [
            { label: 'Done', value: D.totals.done, cls: 'ok', status: 'done' },
            { label: 'Active', value: D.totals.active, cls: 'brand', status: 'active' },
            { label: 'Blocked', value: D.totals.blocked, cls: 'danger', status: 'blocked' },
            { label: 'Queued',
              value: D.totals.total - D.totals.done - D.totals.active - D.totals.blocked,
              cls: 'idle', status: 'pending' }],
          center: D.totals.total, centerSub: 'goals',
          aria: 'Goal mix: ' + D.totals.done + ' done, ' + D.totals.active +
                ' active, ' + D.totals.blocked + ' blocked of ' +
                D.totals.total + ' total.',
          onSlice: function (seg) {
            statusFilter = statusFilter === seg.status ? '' : seg.status;
            renderRecent();
          } });

        var dmax = 1;
        (D.domains || []).forEach(function (r) { dmax = Math.max(dmax, r.total); });
        if ((D.domains || []).length) {
          B.hbars(document.getElementById('bd-domains'),
            D.domains.map(function (r) {
              return { label: r.label, value_text: r.done + ' of ' + r.total,
                       pct: r.done / dmax * 100, pct_bg: r.total / dmax * 100,
                       title: r.label + ' — ' + r.done + ' delivered of ' + r.total };
            }), 'Goals by department: delivered against taken on.');
        } else {
          B.empty(document.getElementById('bd-domains'), 'No departmental work yet.');
        }
        renderRecent();
      }

      B.attach({ board: 'overview', render: render });
    })();
    </script>

        <script src="/static/board.js"></script>
        <script>
        (function () {
          'use strict';
          var B = window.LWBoard, DATA = null, statusFilter = '';
    
          function rel(ts) {
            var secs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000 - ts);
            if (secs < 60) return 'just now';
            if (secs < 3600) return Math.floor(secs / 60) + 'm ago';
            if (secs < 86400) return Math.floor(secs / 3600) + 'h ago';
            return Math.floor(secs / 86400) + 'd ago';
          }
    
          function renderRecent() {
            var box = document.getElementById('bd-recent');
            var chip = document.getElementById('bd-recent-filter');
            chip.hidden = !statusFilter;
            chip.textContent = statusFilter ? statusFilter + ' ✕' : '';
            chip.onclick = function () { statusFilter = ''; renderRecent(); };
            chip.classList.toggle('bd-clickable', !!statusFilter);
            var rows = (DATA.recent || []).filter(function (g) {
              return !statusFilter || g.status === statusFilter;
            });
            if (!rows.length) {
              B.empty(box, statusFilter
                ? 'No recent goals with status "' + statusFilter + '".'
                : 'No goals yet.');
              return;
            }
            box.textContent = '';
            var table = document.createElement('table');
            var thead = document.createElement('thead');
            thead.innerHTML = '<tr><th scope="col">Nº</th><th scope="col">Status</th>' +
              '<th scope="col">Title</th><th scope="col">Updated</th></tr>';
            table.appendChild(thead);
            var tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
            rows.forEach(function (g) {
              var tr = document.createElement('tr');
              var td1 = document.createElement('td');
              var code = document.createElement('code');
              code.textContent = '#' + g.id;
              td1.appendChild(code);
              var td2 = document.createElement('td');
              var badge = B.el('span', 'badge ' + g.status, g.status);
              td2.appendChild(badge);
              var td3 = document.createElement('td');
              var a = document.createElement('a');
              a.href = '/chat/goal/' + g.id;
              a.style.color = 'var(--text)';
              a.style.textDecoration = 'none';
              a.textContent = g.title;
              td3.appendChild(a);
              var td4 = B.el('td', 'muted', rel(g.updated_at));
              td4.title = new Date(g.updated_at * 1000).toLocaleString();
              tr.appendChild(td1); tr.appendChild(td2);
              tr.appendChild(td3); tr.appendChild(td4);
              tbody.appendChild(tr);
            });
            table.appendChild(tbody);
            box.appendChild(table);
          }
    
          function render(D) {
            DATA = D;
            var k = document.getElementById('bd-kpis');
            k.textContent = '';
            k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Total goals', value: D.totals.total,
              sub: 'all time on record',
              spark: D.daily.map(function (r) { return r.started; }) }));
            k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Active now', value: D.totals.active,
              sub: D.totals.active ? 'running under budget caps' : 'nothing in flight' }));
            k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Delivered', value: D.window.delivered,
              chip: { cur: D.window.delivered, prev: D.window.delivered_prev },
              sub: 'in the last ' + D.days + ' days', sparkCls: 'ok',
              spark: D.daily.map(function (r) { return r.delivered; }) }));
            k.appendChild(B.kpi({ label: 'Blocked', value: D.totals.blocked,
              sub: D.totals.blocked ? 'needs a human look' : 'nothing stuck' }));
    
            var weekly = D.days > 60;
            B.area(document.getElementById('bd-momentum'), {
              data: weekly ? B.bucketWeekly(D.daily, ['started', 'delivered']) : D.daily,
              x: 'd',
              series: [{ key: 'started', label: 'Started', cls: 'brand' },
                       { key: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered', cls: 'ok' }],
              aria: 'Goals started and delivered per ' + (weekly ? 'week' : 'day') +
                    ' over the last ' + D.days + ' days.',
              tipHead: function (r) { return (weekly ? 'Week of ' : '') + r.d; },
              xTick: function (r, i, n) {
                return i % Math.ceil(n / 8) === 0 ? r.d.slice(5) : '';
              } });
    
            B.donut(document.getElementById('bd-mix'), {
              segments: [
                { label: 'Done', value: D.totals.done, cls: 'ok', status: 'done' },
                { label: 'Active', value: D.totals.active, cls: 'brand', status: 'active' },
                { label: 'Blocked', value: D.totals.blocked, cls: 'danger', status: 'blocked' },
                { label: 'Queued',
                  value: D.totals.total - D.totals.done - D.totals.active - D.totals.blocked,
                  cls: 'idle', status: 'pending' }],
              center: D.totals.total, centerSub: 'goals',
              aria: 'Goal mix: ' + D.totals.done + ' done, ' + D.totals.active +
                    ' active, ' + D.totals.blocked + ' blocked of ' +
                    D.totals.total + ' total.',
              onSlice: function (seg) {
                statusFilter = statusFilter === seg.status ? '' : seg.status;
                renderRecent();
              } });
    
            var dmax = 1;
            (D.domains || []).forEach(function (r) { dmax = Math.max(dmax, r.total); });
            if ((D.domains || []).length) {
              B.hbars(document.getElementById('bd-domains'),
                D.domains.map(function (r) {
                  return { label: r.label, value_text: r.done + ' of ' + r.total,
                           pct: r.done / dmax * 100, pct_bg: r.total / dmax * 100,
                           title: r.label + ' — ' + r.done + ' delivered of ' + r.total };
                }), 'Goals by department: delivered against taken on.');
            } else {
              B.empty(document.getElementById('bd-domains'), 'No departmental work yet.');
            }
            renderRecent();
          }
    
          B.attach({ board: 'overview', render: render });
        })();
        </script>
